silent_decisions.operation: choose the input dataset and its file path as the analysis source
derive player age from birthday using a fixed 2012 reference season

misalignments.decision: standardize height, weight, and age to z-scores before modeling
misalignments.claim: continuous covariates (number of games, number of yellow cards, player height, weight, age) were included in the model, standardized
misalignments.note: claim states games and yellow cards were standardized; code standardizes only height, weight, and age, leaving games and yellowCards on their raw scale in the model

misalignments.decision: bootstrap the risk difference with 500 resamples-with-replacement, refitting the primary model each iteration and silently discarding non-converging fits
misalignments.claim: bootstrap convergence was achieved in 500 of 500 iterations
misalignments.note: claim reports 500 of 500 iterations converged, but the code silently discards non-converging fits, so retained iterations may be fewer than 500 and full convergence is not guaranteed

misalignments.decision: re-run the primary model at alternative skin-tone cutpoints (0.30, 0.35, 0.375) as a robustness check
misalignments.claim: seven skin tone cutpoints were tested: 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.375, 0.40, 0.45, 0.50
misalignments.note: claim states seven cutpoints (incl. 0.40, 0.45, 0.50) were tested; code only re-runs at 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, and 0.375

misalignments.decision: drop yellowCards from the adjustment set and rerun the model as a robustness check
misalignments.claim: multiple covariate set combinations were tested (with/without yellow cards, with/without physical characteristics, with/without league/position)
misalignments.note: claim states with/without physical characteristics and with/without league/position were also tested; code only drops yellowCards as a covariate-set variation
